findings.explanation: HOL4 saves only dest_var (Var x ty) = (x,ty). The single constructor clause goes through Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (Defn.sml:1182) and new_specification (Prim_rec.sml:281), so nothing is said about dest_var on Const, Comb or Abs; different arguments may have different values. The Lean match sends all of them to the one constant ARB. Lean therefore proves dest_var (Const n ty) = dest_var (Comb s t), and likewise for any two non-Var terms, by rfl. HOL4 leaves these equations open. They carry over to VSUBST, INST_CORE, db and bv_names on Abs with a non-variable binder. OUTL, defined by the same HOL4 mechanism, is translated with Classical.epsilon and does not have this leak.
findings.repair:
noncomputable def dest_var : term → mlstring × type :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun f : term → mlstring × type => ∀ x ty, f (Var x ty) = (x, ty))
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntax

example (n : mlstring) (ty : type) (s t : term) :
    dest_var (term.Const n ty) = dest_var (term.Comb s t) := rfl

example (n m : mlstring) (ty ty' : type) :
    dest_var (term.Const n ty) = dest_var (term.Const m ty') := rfl
